name: XamBaaz — Principal Intro
subject: Free Olympiad for your students on 15 November
body:
Dear Principal,

I'm Bithin Biswas, founder of XamBaaz, an AI-led practice platform for Classes 8 to 12.

On Sunday, 15 November, we're running the free online XamBaaz Olympiad on logical reasoning and data interpretation.

Students take it from home, any time between 11 am and 5 pm. It's 20 questions in 30 minutes, in three groups: Classes 8–9, 10 and 11–12. The topper in each group can win a year of XamBaaz PRO.

Your teachers don't need to do anything. Just share the link with parents.

Would you like a one-page overview, or a quick 10-minute call? Just reply "Overview" or "Call".

Warm regards,
Bithin Biswas
Founder, XamBaaz
xambaaz.com

P.S. If this isn't for you, just reply "stop" and I won't write again.
